description: This file contains utility functions for validating Azure Blob storage container and blob names, including regex-based validation and length checks.

classes.name: AzureBlobUtils
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for Azure Blob storage name validation.

methods.name: ValidateContainerName
methods.description: Validates the container name against length constraints and a regex pattern, throws ArgumentException if invalid.

methods.name: ValidateBlobName
methods.description: Validates the blob name against length constraints and slash count, throws ArgumentException if invalid.
